title: Data Version Metadata
description: Schema for tracking data provenance, integrity, and versioning in the llmXive pipeline.

source_url.description: The exact URL or identifier from which the data was retrieved.

checksum_sha256.description: The SHA-256 hexadecimal checksum of the downloaded raw file to ensure integrity.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) indicating when the data was fetched or verified.
